{{Top|leg}}
The '''Advanced shield disruptor''' was a prototype [[shield disruptor]] created by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that not only devastated [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but also nullified [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]]. This droid utility item was found to have been used by both the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.<ref name="KOTOR" />
